query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Prepare HubSpot launch assets for a paid event registration flow: assess payment-link feasibility, create a review-only automated confirmation email, create a disabled confirmation workflow, verify the assets remain inert, and attempt to create a custom-object registration ledger.
query_ground_truth.intent: Create the review-only automated confirmation email and the disabled confirmation workflow in HubSpot.

requirement_groups.purpose: create or prepare the review-only automated confirmation email

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if avoiding duplicates)] [Prerequisite]: Review existing ticket structures using INTERCOM_LIST_TICKET_TYPES (decide whether to reuse vs create new).
[Required] [Step]: Create the workflow’s ticket container using INTERCOM_CREATE_TICKET_TYPE (define name, category, description, icon).
[Required] [Next Step]: Add workflow fields using INTERCOM_CREATE_TICKET_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE (create attributes like tier/reason/eligibility and store returned attribute IDs).
[Optional (if refining after stakeholder review)] [Next Step]: Adjust ticket type metadata using INTERCOM_UPDATE_TICKET_TYPE (rename, recategorize, or update description/icon without recreating).
[Optional (for verification or documentation)] [Next Step]: Confirm the final ticket schema and defaults using INTERCOM_GET_TICKET_TYPE (ensure attributes and default states match expectations).
known_pitfalls: [INTERCOM_CREATE_TICKET_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE] Requires the ticket_type_id returned by INTERCOM_CREATE_TICKET_TYPE; capture IDs immediately to avoid mis-attaching fields.
[INTERCOM_GET_TICKET_TYPE] Returned schema can include system-added defaults/default states; verify against expectations before announcing the workflow is ready.
[INTERCOM_UPDATE_TICKET_TYPE] Changing metadata post-creation can affect downstream usage; confirm changes before applying updates to an in-use ticket type.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Intercom provides live chat, messaging, and customer engagement tools, enabling businesses to drive conversions, handle support, and personalize communication at scale
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=intercom. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="intercom") to create a connection BEFORE executing any intercom tools.

INTERCOM_CREATE_DATA_EVENT.description: Tool to submit a data event to Intercom to track user activities. Use when you need to notify Intercom of user actions and changes. Events are detected as duplicates using workspace ID, contact identifier, event name, and timestamp.

id.description: Intercom's 24-character UUID identifier for a lead or user. The contact must already exist in Intercom; events cannot be created for non-existent contacts. At least one of user_id, id, or email is required.

email.description: The user's email address. The contact with this email must already exist in Intercom; events cannot be created for non-existent contacts. Use only when email uniquely identifies users. At least one of user_id, id, or email is required.

user_id.description: Your application's unique identifier for the user. The contact must already exist in Intercom with this user_id; events cannot be created for non-existent contacts. At least one of user_id, id, or email is required.

metadata.description: Additional key-value pairs providing context about the event. Can include custom properties relevant to the event.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the event occurred.

event_name.description: The name of the event in past tense verb-noun format (e.g., 'updated-plan', 'purchased-item'). Describes what action occurred.

INTERCOM_CREATE_TICKET_TYPE.description: Tool to create a new ticket type that defines the data structure for tracking customer requests. Use when you need to establish a new category of tickets with specific fields and states.

name.description: The designation for the ticket type

description.description: Explanatory text about the ticket type

is_internal.description: Whether tickets are for internal use only; defaults to false

INTERCOM_CREATE_TICKET_TYPE_ATTRIBUTE.description: Tool to create a new attribute for a ticket type in Intercom. Use when you need to add custom attributes to ticket types for data collection.

name.description: The name of the ticket type attribute

data_type.description: The data type of the attribute. Allowed values: string, list, integer, decimal, boolean, datetime, files

multiline.description: Whether the attribute allows multiple lines of text (applicable for string data_type only)

list_items.description: A comma delimited list of items for the attribute value (applicable for list data_type only)

examples: Select the priority level for this ticket
description.description: The description of the attribute presented to the teammate or contact

ticket_type_id.description: The unique identifier of the ticket type to add the attribute to

visible_on_create.description: Visibility to teammates during creation (default: true)

required_to_create.description: Whether teammates must fill this attribute when creating tickets (default: false)

visible_to_contacts.description: Visibility to contacts in Messenger (default: true)

allow_multiple_values.description: Whether the attribute allows multiple files to be attached (applicable for files data_type only)

required_to_create_for_contacts.description: Whether contacts must fill this attribute in Messenger (default: false)

INTERCOM_UPDATE_TICKET_TYPE.description: Tool to update an existing ticket type in the workspace. Use when you need to modify a ticket type's name, description, category, icon, or archive status.

icon.description: An emoji icon (copy from Twemoji Cheatsheet).

archived.description: Archived status of the ticket type.

category.description: One of: Customer, Back-office, or Tracker.

examples: Updated description for customer issue ticket type

is_internal.description: Whether tickets are internal-only or shared with customers.

ticket_type_id.description: The unique identifier of the ticket type to update.

INTERCOM_LIST_DATA_EVENTS.description: Tool to retrieve a log of data events belonging to a customer. Use when you need to list events for a specific user. Note: Only events less than 90 days old can be listed.

email.description: Contact's email address. Required if user_id and intercom_user_id are not provided.

summary.description: Flag to include event summaries in response

user_id.description: Your internal identifier for the user. Required if intercom_user_id and email are not provided.

intercom_user_id.description: Intercom's identifier for the contact. Required if user_id and email are not provided.
